units.source_text: 这个村子是在二月一日过新年，所以还留下稻草绳。

en.t: This village celebrates New Year on February first, so the straw ropes are still left up.

units.source_text: 于是，孩子们爬上雪殿堂的屋顶，你推我挤，乱作一团地唱起赶鸟歌。

en.t: Then the children climb onto the roof of the snow shrine, jostling and shoving one another as they burst into the bird-chasing song.

units.source_text: 然后，拥进雪殿堂里，点上明灯，在那儿过夜。

en.t: After that, they crowd into the snow shrine, light the lamps, and spend the night there.

units.source_text: 直到十五日黎明时分，又一次爬上雪殿堂的屋顶，唱起赶鸟歌。

en.t: At dawn on the fifteenth, they climb onto the roof of the snow shrine once more and begin singing the bird-chasing song again.

units.source_text: 那时正是积雪最厚的时分，岛村同驹子相约来看赶鸟节。

en.t: Since that was just when the snow lay deepest, Shimamura had arranged with Komako to come and see the bird-chasing festival.
